title: Before the Engine
hook: The key's in your hand. You haven't turned it.
scene: The lot's wet and empty and the car has been sitting since yesterday, which is long enough for a lot of small things to change without asking you. Gracie and Mya are already on the seat. The key's in your hand.
decision: Before you start it, what do you do?

options.text: Turn the key. You already know this car.
options.result: It catches on the first try, the way it always does. You pull out on everything you knew yesterday. The car sat all night in a lot that didn't stay the same shape while it did.

options.text: Get out and walk it, all the way around
options.result: Tires. Glass. Nothing behind the bumper, nothing under it. Both doors shut the way you left them. It takes forty seconds and then the key means something.

options.text: Check your phone, then start it
options.result: You read the screen. The screen doesn't know anything about the ground around your wheels, and now you've spent the only time you were going to give this.

options.text: Open the door, sit back down, start it
options.result: You get half out, look at nothing in particular, and sit down again. The engine starts on the same view you already had.

debrief: Walk the car before you start it — tires, glass, and the ground around the wheels.

source.psdp_skill: Skill one: before you start the engine
source.teaching_target: Before the engine. Walk the car once. Do not start from memory.
